title: ProteinMPNN Deep Graph Network Solves Inverse Protein Folding & Rescues Failed De Novo Folds
aiSystem: ProteinMPNN (Message-Passing Graph Neural Network — UW IPD)
whyItMatters: Solved the inverse protein-folding bottleneck with a fast message-passing GNN (52.4% vs. 32.9% native recovery), rescuing previously unexpressible de novo proteins and becoming the universal sequence-design engine paired with RFdiffusion.
summary: Published in Science in September 2022 by Justas Dauparas, Ivan Anishchenko, Nathaniel Bennett, David Baker, and colleagues at the University of Washington Institute for Protein Design (IPD), ProteinMPNN introduced a lightweight message-passing graph neural network that designs amino-acid sequences for arbitrary 3D protein backbones in ~1 second—more than 200× faster than physics-based Rosetta design. ProteinMPNN raised native sequence recovery on held-out monomers from 32.9% (Rosetta) to 52.4%, rescued previously failed protein monomers, symmetric cyclic homo-oligomers, tetrahedral nanoparticles, and enzyme scaffolds in wet-lab expression assays, and verified atomic-level accuracy via X-ray crystallography and cryo-EM.
technicalHighlights: Order-agnostic autoregressive message-passing GNN over 3D backbone coordinates supporting multi-chain, symmetric, and fixed-residue design constraints.
Achieved 52.4% native sequence recovery (vs. 32.9% for Rosetta) in ~1 second on a single CPU, slashing experimental failure rates across complex assemblies.
Rescued dozens of previously failed de novo protein designs in wet-lab assays with sub-angstrom experimental X-ray and cryo-EM crystal verification.
caveats: Designs sequences conditioned solely on protein backbones without explicitly modeling small-molecule ligands or nucleic acids (subsequently addressed by LigandMPNN and all-atom diffusion models).

scoreRationale.foundational: Cracked the deep-learning inverse folding problem with an elegant, rock-solid geometric graph architecture.
scoreRationale.ripple: Became the indispensable sequence-design half of nearly every modern generative protein pipeline (RFdiffusion, BindCraft, RFantibody, antivenoms, enzymes).
scoreRationale.verification: Peer-reviewed in Science with extensive wet-lab expression, thermal stability, X-ray crystallography, and cryo-EM structural verification.
scoreRationale.velocity: Accelerated sequence design >200× over Rosetta (seconds vs. hours) while dramatically raising experimental success rates.
